title.en: An Act Declaring March 26 of Every Year a Special Nonworking Holiday in the Municipality of Talisay, Province of Cebu
title.orig: An Act Declaring March 26 of Every Year a Special Nonworking Holiday in the Municipality of Talisay, Province of Cebu
title.vi: Đạo luật tuyên bố ngày 26 tháng 3 hằng năm là ngày nghỉ lễ đặc biệt tại Đô thị Talisay, Tỉnh Cebu
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติประกาศให้วันที่ 26 มีนาคมของทุกปีเป็นวันหยุดพิเศษในเทศบาล Talisay จังหวัด Cebu
title.id: Undang-Undang menetapkan tanggal 26 Maret setiap tahun sebagai hari libur khusus di Kotamadya Talisay, Provinsi Cebu
title.ms: Akta mengisytiharkan 26 Mac setiap tahun sebagai hari cuti khas di Perbandaran Talisay, Wilayah Cebu

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1992/ra_7280_1992.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: March 26 of every year is hereby declared a special nonworking holiday in the Municipality of Talisay, Province of Cebu.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
